subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this stack land with the new generic `prepareFlow` plugin API and production `runOutsideGatewayRootWorkAdmission` channel-restart behavior, after exact-head dependency authorization and conflict resolution?
rationale: Tests establish the proposed behavior, but automation cannot decide whether these compatibility-sensitive API and Gateway lifecycle boundaries are the intended permanent architecture or whether the production change should be reviewed separately.

options.title: Approve the integrated scope
options.body: Confirm both architectural boundaries, resolve the conflicts, authorize the final dependency graph, and rerun exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Split the Gateway lifecycle change
options.body: Keep the Matrix catalog migration and adapter hook here, but move the production work-admission helper and reload call sites into a separately reviewed PR.

options.title: Pause the migration stack
options.body: Do not land this stack if QA Lab should not own Matrix scenarios through this generic API or if the compatibility shim plan is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Approve the integrated scope
recommendation.body: Confirm both architectural boundaries, resolve the conflicts, authorize the final dependency graph, and rerun exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged prerequisite and current migration stack and are best positioned to present the intended boundary for final owner approval.
